title: Free time: loud or quiet?
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le, hogyan töltik a szabadidejüket a fiatalok, hasonlítsd össze a két képet, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: A big crowd of young people are at an open-air music festival on a summer evening. A band is playing on a large stage with bright coloured lights. At the front, a group of friends are jumping, singing and waving their hands in the air. Some of them have painted faces, and they are clearly having a great time.

A girl of about sixteen is sitting in an armchair by the window of her room on a rainy Sunday afternoon. She is reading a thick book and has a cup of hot chocolate on the small table next to her. Her cat is sleeping on her legs under a blanket. Outside, the trees are moving in the wind, but inside it is warm and quiet.

prompts: Describe what the young people are doing and how they feel.
Compare the two ways of spending free time.
Which one would you choose for your weekend? Why?
followUpQuestions: Have you ever been to a festival or a concert? Tell me about it.
Do you prefer spending your free time with friends or alone?
What kind of books or stories do you enjoy?
What do you do on rainy days?
Do you think young people read less than before? Why?

usefulPhrases.en: She's relaxing with a good book.
Some people need excitement, others need peace and quiet.
usefulPhrases.hu: Van, akinek izgalom kell, másnak nyugalom.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The first picture shows an open-air music festival on a summer evening. A band is playing on a big stage, and at the front a group of friends with painted faces are jumping and singing. They look really excited. In the second picture a girl is reading a thick book in an armchair on a rainy Sunday afternoon. She's got a cup of hot chocolate, and her cat is sleeping on her legs, so she seems calm and relaxed. The first picture is loud and full of energy, while the second one is quiet and peaceful. But in both pictures the young people are enjoying their free time. For my weekend I'd choose the second one, because after a busy week at school I need some rest.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you ever been to a festival or a concert? Tell me about it.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, last summer I went to a music festival in Zamárdi with my friends. It was amazing, although we hardly slept for three days.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó leírja, mit csinálnak és hogyan éreznek a képeken látható fiatalok, összehasonlítja a két időtöltést (különbség és közös pont), indoklással választ, majd saját fesztiválélményt mesél.
Szókincs: az érzések és a hangulat leírására változatos szavakat használ (excited, calm and relaxed, full of energy, peaceful, amazing).
Nyelvhelyesség: a „look / seem + melléknév” szerkezet helyes (They look really excited; she seems calm), az ellentétet a „while” és az „although” köti össze, a múltbeli élmény egyszerű múltban áll.
Érdemes megtanulni: „full of energy”, „she seems calm and relaxed”, „For my weekend I'd choose …”, „we hardly slept for three days”.
